demonstrates: Built one audit engine shared by eighteen research wikis, where each wiki declares which kind of proof its citations owe (PDF hash, captured-page hash, resolving vault query, git blob, or explicitly nothing), the same rules run on the filesystem, in the database write transaction and through an MCP tool, and a separate guard checks each wiki's index counts against disk.
